result.title: Training Small Language Models for Transferable Tool Selection
result.summary: As LLM agents operate over corpora of more than ten thousand tools, selecting the right tool for a complex multi-step user instruction becomes a central bottleneck. Tool descriptions cannot all fit in context, and relevance-based retrievers only rank tools without knowing which are actually needed. Recent work instead leverages proprietary commercial LLMs like Claude or ChatGPT to drive a retriever, decomposing the instruction and selecting over retrieved candidates. We show that a small, open model can be trained via reinforcement learning to perform the same functionality. On ToolBench, a Qwen3-8B model post-trained with our recipe outperforms Llama-4-Maverick (402B). In addition, the trained model transfers directly to different retrievers and generalizes to new tool corpora in different domains.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文用强化学习后训练小型开源模型（Qwen3-8B），使其能分解复杂多步指令并在超万级工具库中驱动检索器完成工具选择，在 ToolBench 上超过 402B 的商业模型，且可迁移到其他检索器与新领域工具语料。
AI.relevance_reason: 其用 RL 训练模型自行分解任务并选择候选、并检验跨检索器与跨语料泛化的做法，可供核查 VLM 中「何时、何处获取证据」的训练监督与泛化成本问题；但属纯文本工具选择任务，与视觉 latent 表示无直接联系。
